# PS2 Save Tool Web

PS2 Save Tool Web is a browser-based utility for PlayStation 1 and PlayStation 2 save files and memory card images.

Core capabilities:
- Inspect and convert PS2 PSV and PSU saves, including MAX export.
- Inspect PS2 memory card images and export individual saves as PSV, PSU or MAX.
- Manage files inside a selected PS2 save: extract, replace, add, delete and export as a folder archive.
- Create PS1 and PS2 memory card images.
- Inspect PS1 saves and memory cards and convert supported PS1 formats without mixing PS1 and PS2 save types.
- Preview PS1 icons and PS2 rendered / raw texture icons.
- Merge compatible PS2 memory cards.
- Inject a compatible modified PS2 save into a PS3 PSV container and re-sign it.
- Rebuild a PS2 card into a new image as an experimental repair workflow.

Project author: Chrisser73
Project profile: https://github.com/Chrisser73/
